name: 200mg | Grapefruit 2:1:1 CBG:CBC Sativa Enhanced Gummies
description:
Our Grapefruit CBG:CBC gummies are made with real fruit and a Sativa enhanced botanical terpene blend, making them a great addition to a day out and about. Whether eaten for a creative boost, or prepping for a dance party, these gummies are great for carefree adventures.

200mg THC:100mg:CBG:100mg CBC per container, 20mg THC:10mg CBG:10mg CBC per gummy.
